whatItIs: QuantumGraphs is an open-source project in the visualization and tomography category. It is maintained by ziofil and primarily looks like a Python codebase. Introduction This package is for growing random graphs and trees by using continuous quantum walks:

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches visualization and tomography workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: Introduction This package is for growing random graphs and trees by using continuous quantum walks: One or more quantum walkers evolve on a graph, and at random times their wave function collapses on its nodes. A new node is attached to all the nodes where a walker collapsed.
whoItsFor: People who learn best by seeing state structure, measurement results, or circuit behavior laid out visually.
whatYouCanBuild: Understand how the project helps inspect or reconstruct quantum systems.
Compare visual tooling against more code-heavy workflows.
